name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair with City Dweller LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair with City Dweller LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial inspection to assess the full extent of the storm damage and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we assist with insurance claims documentation, if needed. Next, we schedule the repairs, prioritizing safety and immediate mitigation to prevent further damage. Our experienced team then performs the necessary repairs, from roof and structural work to interior restoration, using quality materials. We conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction and restore your property to its pre-storm condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial inspection, estimate, insurance claim assistance, scheduled repairs, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
